salami.category.utility.warning: Warning: combat automation is forbidden on most servers and will get you banned there. Only use it in singleplayer, on your own servers or where it is explicitly allowed.
salami.clickgui.title: Salami Client
salami.clickgui.hint: Left click: toggle  ·  Right click: settings  ·  Drag header: move
salami.setting.keybind.desc: Left click: set key  ·  Right click or Delete: clear  ·  Esc: cancel
salami.module.crashed: %s ran into an error and was disabled (see log).
salami.module.salami_theme.desc: The whole client in salami style. When started from the Salami launcher, the launcher setting wins.
salami.module.safe_mode.desc: Turns off and locks all utility (combat) modules. Also activated by the Easy Leave key (default: End).
salami.module.safe_mode.setting.auto_ser: Enable Safe Mode automatically when joining a server from the list.
salami.safe_mode.on: Safe Mode active – all combat modules are off.
salami.safe_mode.server: Server is on the safe list: Safe Mode active, %s combat module(s) turned off.
salami.safe_mode.blocked: Safe Mode is active. Turn off Client → Safe Mode first.
salami.easy_leave.done: Easy Leave: %s combat module(s) turned off. Safe Mode is active.
salami.module.watermark.desc: Salami logo and name in the top left corner.
salami.module.auto_totem.desc: Automatically puts a totem into your offhand.
salami.module.auto_totem.setting.mode.de: Always: refill at any time. Inventory only: only while the inventory is open.
Only replace other offhand items (e.g. crystals) when your health is at most this. 20 = always.
salami.module.hover_totem.desc: In the inventory, the totem under your mouse moves into your offhand automatically.
salami.module.double_hand_totem.desc: Keeps a second totem in a hotbar slot and switches to it when your health is low.
salami.module.auto_crystal.desc: Places crystals on the obsidian/bedrock you look at and breaks crystals you look at.
salami.module.auto_crystal.setting.min_h: Self-kill protection: below this health (incl. absorption) no crystals are broken.
salami.module.capes.desc: Your own cape (and elytra) in salami style. Only visible to you.
salami.module.capes.setting.cape.desc: "From launcher" uses the cape you picked under Capes in the launcher. "Custom" loads config/salami/cape.png in the profile folder.
salami.capes.custom_missing: Salami Capes: No custom cape found. Put it here: %s
salami.capes.custom_invalid: Salami Capes: cape.png is not a valid cape image (PNG up to 4 MiB, width twice the height, 64–2048 px wide in steps of 64).
salami.module.particles.desc: Hides particles by source – e.g. explosions in crystal PvP or the totem cloud.
salami.module.anchor_macro.desc: Charges and detonates the respawn anchor you look at. One right-click is enough – the macro keeps going until the explosion. Safe Anchor places glowstone as cover first.
salami.module.anchor_macro.setting.safe_: Places a glowstone block between you and the anchor before detonating. Without room for it, the anchor is not detonated.
salami.module.anchor_macro.setting.switc: After the explosion, switches back to the slot you held before the macro started.
salami.anchor.no_shield: Safe Anchor: no room for the glowstone cover – anchor not detonated.
salami.anchor.sneaking: Anchor Macro: the anchor can't be used while sneaking – stop sneaking.
salami.module.ghost_spear.desc: Runs drop → offhand swap → slot switch automatically (spear in hand). Turns itself off afterwards – best bound to a key.
Ticks between steps. 0 = everything in the same tick.
salami.ghost_spear.no_spear: Ghost Spear: you need a spear in your main hand.
salami.module.live_tracker.desc: Shows above enemies' names which armor they are wearing (with durability).
salami.clickgui.scale.tooltip: Menu size · click the percentage to reset · also Ctrl + mouse wheel or Ctrl + / Ctrl −
salami.hud_editor.title: HUD editor
salami.hud_editor.hint: Drag elements with the mouse  ·  Esc: back
salami.module.breach_swap.desc: Swaps to a Breach mace in the same tick as your hit – the hit pierces armor. Then swaps back to your weapon.
salami.module.attribute_swap.desc: Swaps to another weapon in the same tick as your hit: its enchantments apply, attack values and charge still come from the old one.
salami.module.auto_mace.desc: When you fall onto a target you aim at, swaps to the mace and strikes automatically – one hit per fall.
salami.module.auto_elytra.desc: Puts on the elytra and glides when falling; swaps back to the chestplate before landing or for a mace hit.
salami.module.speed_lunge.desc: Jabs automatically with a Lunge spear whenever the charge allows – every jab pushes you forward. Costs durability and hunger.
salami.module.player_esp.desc: Shows other players through walls – as a box or a glowing outline.
salami.module.player_esp.setting.health_: Green at full health, through yellow to red.
salami.module.trigger_bot.desc: Attacks automatically as soon as a target is in your crosshair and the attack is charged.
salami.module.trigger_bot.setting.cooldo: 1.0 = full damage. Lower hits more often but weaker.
salami.module.trigger_bot.setting.wait_f: Wait for crit in the air
After a jump, only hit while falling (critical hit). Normal on the ground.
salami.module.aim_assist.desc: Gently pulls your aim towards the nearest target in your field of view.
salami.module.aim_assist.setting.click_o: Only helps while the attack key is held.
salami.module.gui_scale.desc: Size of the Salami HUD elements and the ClickGUI – on top of Minecraft's GUI scale.
salami.module.gui_scale.setting.hud_scal: Applies to all HUD elements (on top of their own size).
salami.module.gui_scale.setting.clickgui: Applied as soon as you release the slider.
salami.module.auto_dtap.desc: After every crystal you break, places and breaks a new one on the same block right away (double tap).
salami.module.auto_dtap.setting.min_heal: Below this health (incl. absorption) no extra crystal is placed.
salami.module.auto_shield_break.desc: If the target blocks with a shield, switches to an axe for the hit – that disables the shield.
Attacks automatically as soon as a blocking player is in your crosshair.
salami.module.bow_spam.desc: While holding right-click, shoots automatically after a short draw and draws again right away.
salami.module.bow_aim.desc: Aims at the nearest target while drawing – with arrow trajectory and lead.
salami.module.bow_aim.setting.predict.de: Aims where the target will be when the arrow arrives.
salami.module.block_esp.desc: Highlights nearby blocks with boxes – optionally through walls.
salami.module.crosshair.desc: Your own crosshair instead of the vanilla one.
salami.module.block_outline.desc: Colored outline for the block you look at.
salami.module.item_counter.desc: How many totems, crystals, apples and pearls you have left.
salami.module.combo_counter.desc: Counts your hits in a row – ends when you get hit or stop hitting for a while.
salami.module.combo_counter.label: Combo: %s
salami.module.logo_overlay.desc: Large salami logo overlay, e.g. for recordings and streams.
salami.module.kits.desc: Ready-made inventory layouts for PvP modes. The apply key (default K) sorts your inventory to match the kit.
Saves your current inventory as a custom kit (the selected custom kit, otherwise Custom 1).
salami.mods.title: Salami Mods
salami.module.side_shield.desc: While blocking, your shield moves aside, down and gets smaller in first person – more view in the middle of the screen.
salami.module.hide_armor.desc: Hides armour – only yours or on every player. Visual only, only on your screen.
salami.module.low_fire.desc: The fire overlay sits lower and blocks less of your view.
salami.module.no_hurt_cam.desc: The camera no longer shakes when you take damage.
salami.module.hit_color.desc: Your own colour for players and mobs that get hit.
salami.module.hitbox.desc: Shows the hitboxes of players and mobs (like F3 + B). Not on servers with reduced debug info.
salami.module.fullbright.desc: Everything bright – even in caves and at night. Visual only.
salami.module.zoom.desc: Hold the key (default C) to zoom in; the mouse wheel changes the strength.
salami.module.nametags.desc: Shows your own name in third person and sets the background of name tags.
salami.module.keystrokes.desc: Shows WASD, mouse buttons with CPS and the space bar – pressed keys light up.
salami.module.potion_status.desc: Active effects with icon, level and time left – blinks shortly before they run out.
salami.module.reach_display.desc: Distance of your last hit in blocks.
salami.module.reach_display.label: Reach: %s
salami.module.shield_status.desc: Shows whether an axe disabled your shield and for how long.
salami.module.toggle_sprint.desc: Press the sprint key once instead of holding it – or always sprint while walking forward.
salami.module.free_look.desc: Hold the key (default: left Alt) to look around in third person without turning your character.
salami.module.fov_changer.desc: Your own field of view up to 150° and optionally without zooming while sprinting or from Speed.
salami.module.no_fog.desc: Removes the fog at the edge of your view distance and optionally under water and in lava.
salami.module.time_changer.desc: Your own time of day – only on your screen, nobody else notices.
salami.module.weather_changer.desc: Your own weather – only on your screen. Clear view despite rain, or rain for the mood.
salami.module.clear_background.desc: No darkening behind inventories and chests, no blur behind the pause menu.
salami.module.item_physics.desc: Dropped items lie flat on the ground instead of floating and spinning.
salami.module.glint_colorizer.desc: Your own colour for the glint of enchanted items and armour.
salami.module.shiny_pots.desc: Potions shine again like they used to.
salami.module.arrow_trail.desc: Flying arrows leave a particle trail (only visible to you).
salami.module.tnt_timer.desc: Shows the time until the explosion above lit TNT.
salami.module.item_model.desc: Freely adjust the position and size of the items in your hand.
salami.module.light_level.desc: Marks blocks where monsters can spawn: red = always, yellow = only at night.
salami.module.health_indicators.desc: Shows health next to player names (optionally named mobs too).
salami.module.color_saturation.desc: Makes the world's colours stronger or paler. HUD and menus stay unchanged.
salami.module.motion_blur.desc: Movement leaves soft trails. Costs a little GPU performance.
salami.module.old_animations.desc: Your hand no longer lowers after a hit (like before 1.9), optionally not when switching items either.
salami.module.scoreboard.desc: Hide the red numbers, change size and background of the sidebar, or hide it completely.
salami.module.titles.desc: Make big titles smaller or hide them, move or hide the text above the hotbar.
salami.module.clock.label: Time
salami.module.speedometer.desc: Your speed in blocks per second.
salami.module.speedometer.label: Speed
salami.module.uptime.desc: How long you have been on this server or in this world.
salami.module.uptime.label: Playtime
salami.module.day_counter.label: Day
salami.module.tps.desc: Estimated server ticks per second (20 = smooth).
salami.module.resource_pack_display.desc: Shows the top active resource pack.
salami.module.jump_reset.desc: Shows how well-timed your jump was after a hit. Display only, for practice.
salami.module.jump_reset.label: Jump reset
salami.module.auto_text.desc: Up to five keys that send your own message or a command ("/…") – at most once per second.
salami.module.streamer_mode.desc: Replaces your name in chat, the tab list and above your head and hides coordinates in the Salami HUD. Only on your screen.
salami.module.no_advancement.desc: No advancement pop-ups in the top right, optionally no recipe pop-ups and chat messages either.
salami.module.auto_reconnect.desc: After a disconnect: a button to reconnect, optionally with a countdown.
salami.module.confirm_disconnect.desc: "Disconnect" asks first – no more leaving by accident.
salami.module.confirm_disconnect.title: Really disconnect?
salami.module.confirm_disconnect.questio: Do you really want to disconnect?
salami.module.chat_tweaks.desc: Time in front of every message and a longer chat history.
salami.module.tab_tweaks.desc: Ping in the tab list as a coloured number instead of bars.
salami.module.borderless_fullscreen.desc: F11 makes a borderless window instead of real fullscreen – Alt+Tab without flicker.
salami.module.waypoints.desc: Waypoints per server and world (key B), automatically on death, with a beam and distance.
salami.module.waypoints.full: Too many waypoints in this world (max. 500).
salami.module.waypoints.empty: No waypoints yet – press B or "+ Here".
salami.external.wavey_capes.desc: Capes wave realistically in the wind.
salami.external.skin_layers.desc: The outer skin layer becomes three-dimensional.
salami.external.tiers.desc: PvP tiers next to player names.
salami.external.appleskin.desc: Shows saturation and how much food restores.
salami.external.shulker_tooltip.desc: Preview of shulker box contents in the tooltip.
salami.colorpicker.hint: Left click: pick a color (field, hue, opacity, hex, rainbow)  ·  Right click: reset
salami.setting.custom_colors.desc: Off: Salami theme colors. On: pick the colors below.
salami.module.gui_scale.setting.custom_c: Custom colors for the ClickGUI, the mods menu and every HUD element without its own colors.
